##### Project general facts

Lyvin Melasti is a premium hospitality development by Lyvin Properties, an award-winning developer recognized internationally for excellence in real estate. Located on a hillside spanning an expansive site, this exclusive complex features private villas and designer apartments, all within a unique natural setting framed by a canyon and tropical forest. With a long-term land lease structure, the project offers a secure and transparent path to profitable real estate investment in Bali.

Residents and guests enjoy an exceptional range of amenities designed for ultimate comfort. The complex features a signature Middle Eastern restaurant, a panoramic bar, a twenty-five-meter swimming pool, a fully equipped fitness center, and a spa. The development is strategically located near world-renowned hotels such as Bulgari, Alila, Six Senses, and Karma Kandara, with their restaurants and beach clubs open to visitors. A dedicated buggy service ensures effortless mobility throughout the property.

Every villa and apartment at Lyvin Melasti is a masterpiece of design, blending Japanese minimalism with Scandinavian functionality and warmth. Interiors feature panoramic glazing that frames breathtaking ocean views, while a conscious effort is made to minimize plastic use in harmony with Bali’s natural environment. Villas include two spacious bedrooms, each with an en-suite bathroom and work area, a generous living room with a fully equipped kitchen, and a private terrace with an infinity pool, ready to impress from the moment of arrival. 

##### Leasehold:
• First phase: 36 + 50 years (total 86 years)

• Second phase: 40 + 50 years (total 90 years)

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the Melasti area on Bali’s southern coast within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents in one of the island’s greenest and most prestigious districts. Known for its stunning beaches and developed infrastructure, the area is highly sought after by leading global hotel brands due to the limited number of ocean-view land parcels available. The location offers a secluded, peaceful hillside setting without neighbors, yet remains just minutes from the main road artery.

The area is distinguished by its exceptional natural beauty and world-class amenities. The most beautiful beach in Bali is just a short drive from the complex, while legendary beach clubs, helipads, paragliding, golf courses, surf spots, yoga studios, and biohacking centers are all within easy reach. The neighborhood is also home to premium resorts, providing access to fine dining and exclusive beach clubs.

For those seeking a residence that embodies both tranquility and prestige, Melasti delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of ocean views, lush greenery, and proximity to the island’s finest attractions has made it a top choice for discerning travelers and investors alike. This is a place where natural beauty meets sophisticated living, an ideal setting for those who demand the very best.
